title: Scriptorium Reading Note v1
description: A per-paper staged interpretation produced by the read-paper agent task as you read at the depth you need. The four OPTIONAL stages are glance / close_read / deep_read / situate, each filled on demand. Joined to the rest of the suite by `id` = the Better BibTeX citekey. Steward can render it to Markdown; Obsidian is an optional client. Provenance locally ingests validated files as reference-only research artifacts, not approved claims. Additive contract — supersedes nothing. See specs/literature-reading.md §3.

id.description: Better BibTeX citekey — the universal join id across the suite (library-kb, lineage, project linked_literature).

zotero_key.description: Zotero item key, if known (same shape as library-kb item keys).

doi.description: DOI of the paper, if known.

read_status.description: Reading progress, mirrors the zotero-reading-list plugin states; the read-paper skill bumps this as depth advances.

created.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time when the note was first created.

generated_by.description: Producer tag, e.g. the read-paper skill + agent.

stages.description: The four reading levels. Each stage is OPTIONAL and filled on demand as you read deeper.

glance.description: 速览 — fast orientation, seeded from library-kb.

close_read.description: 精读 — full-text read against the parsed sections + your annotations.

deep_read.description: 深度审读 — critique + relation to your own work (uses Provenance memory).

situate.description: 串联定位 — place the paper in its research-direction lineage.

lineage_refs.description: Citekeys of related papers in the lineage.

sources.description: Provenance of the evidence the stages are built from (anti-fabrication: figures/data/citations reference these, never invented).

annotations.description: PDF++ / Zotero annotation references (markdown / Zotero API).

parsed_file.description: Path to the GROBID/MinerU-parsed structured file.
